# NuScale Power Module (NPM) — Product Page

## Key Specifications
- **First and only SMR to receive NRC design approval**.
- Based on proven **pressurized water-cooled reactor** technology.
- **Generating capacity: 77 MW per module**.
- **Capacity factor: >95%**.
- Module dimensions: **76' x 15'** cylindrical containment vessel.
- Module weight: **~700 tons** (shipped in 3 segments via truck, rail, or barge).
- Fuel: Standard LWR fuel, **17x17 configuration**, 2m assemblies.
- **Refueling cycle: up to 21 months** (fuel enriched <5%).
- **36-month construction** (factory built, off-the-shelf components).
- **Walk-away safe**: shut down and self-cool indefinitely with no operator action, no AC/DC power, no additional water.
- Scalable: modules added incrementally.
- **12-module plant: up to 924 MWe** (can power data centers, replace retiring coal plants, power micro-grids).
- 12-module plant can power mission-critical facility micro-grid at **154 MWe for 12 years** without new fuel.
- 6-module plant: ~40% emission reduction when coupled to 230,000 bpd refinery.
- Resilient to severe weather, aircraft impact, EMP, cyber attacks.
